text:
lina: Quick thread to finalize CapacityFlex pilot pricing and negotiation boundaries. Customers want predictable uplift for bursty launches and a simple conversion to compute-units. What do we ship for pilot vs GA?

omar: Tech note: can support per-tenant reserve + burst pool. Recommend two SKUs: CapacityFlex-Standard (1.8x) and CapacityFlex-Plus (2.5x + burst tokens). Need cluster policing. Example knobs: `tenant_hard_qps=2800`, `tenant_soft_qps=5600`, `burst_window_sec=600`, `burst_tokens_month=120000`. Telemetry: cf.qps, cf.burst_used, cf.throttle_count.

carlos-eng: Operational caveat: if many tenants burst simultaneously we must enforce cross-tenant fairness and an emergency clamp. We'll ship a feature-flag `capacityflex` and admin override for emergency reclamation.

becky-sales: Pricing proposal for pilot (simple examples for sales deck):
CapacityFlex-Standard: $1,900/mo + $0.08 per 1k tokens overage
CapacityFlex-Plus: $4,800/mo + $0.045 per 1k tokens, includes 120k burst tokens
Pilot incentive: 30% off month 1 or 75k trial burst tokens. Negotiable levers: commit term, included tokens, priority in queue. Non-negotiable: unlimited burst.

legal-bot: Contract flag: define "burst token" precisely (CU vs token-equivalent). Add standard clause: "Burst tokens allocate prioritized routing but are not a guarantee of capacity; provider may throttle to preserve platform stability." Any SLA uplift must be escalated.

billing-bot: Billing needs SKUs `capacityflex.std` and `capacityflex.plus`, meter `cf.burst_tokens_used`, invoice tag `pilot_discount=true`. Support CU conversion table in billing spec.

qa-bot: Feature-flag tests queued. Please ensure 30d log retention for pilot telemetry and alerting for cluster pool <20%.

lina: Launch/pilot checklist: 1) 2 signed pilots billed, 2) console shows burst balance, 3) billing meter + invoice sample, 4) telemetry + alerts, 5) legal-approved burst clause, 6) runbook for cluster exhaustion. Target pilot in ~4w.

becky-sales: I'll reach out to three potential pilots today (OrbitApps, NovaPay, MetroCart). Sales playbook will include negotiation levers and sample language rejecting "unlimited" asks.

omar: One more tech note: convert burst tokens to compute-units for mixed-model customers. I'll draft a CU conversion table for billing.

lina: Thanks. If no objections I'll lock pilot pricing and hand to legal tomorrow. Quick sync Friday if needed.
